claims.call: The Maple Leafs’ power play creates at least their usual 7.9 expected goals per 60.
claims.body: The Sharks’ penalty kill is one of the league’s worst, and the Maple Leafs’ power play is near the top. Discipline matters more than usual for the Sharks tonight.

notes.text: The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 7 games cover only 29% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the third-lowest in the league (a typical team: 45%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Darnell Nurse is day to day and missed their last game. He is a top-pair defenseman. Dmitry Orlov has taken his spot beside Michael Kesselring.
Chris Tanev is out week to week (upper body injury) and has missed the last 2 games. He is one of their most valuable skaters. Darren Raddysh has taken his spot beside Jake McCabe.
John Tavares is out week to week (lower body injury), reported after he played in their last game. He is one of their more valuable skaters.
Marshall Rifai was added to the roster on Oct 12.

TOR.head: The Maple Leafs have a slight edge
TOR.body: Even though Toronto has home-ice advantage, the Maple Leafs will be without Tavares, and San Jose has been out-chancing opponents lately. Still, it’s close: the Sharks can make it interesting if they keep shots to a minimum.

SJS.head: Close, but the Maple Leafs have the slight edge
SJS.body: Even though Toronto has home-ice advantage, the Maple Leafs will be without Tavares, and San Jose has been out-chancing opponents lately. The Sharks can tip it if they keep shots to a minimum.
